newsitem.title: UK: Manchester reviews its 4.0 bln stg fund managers.
newsitem.headline: Manchester reviews its 4.0 bln stg fund managers.

text.p: The Greater Manchester Pension Fund said it was looking for tenders for management of its four billion sterling UK local authority pension fund.
Fund spokesman Peter Morris told Reuters it was looking to appoint two or three managers. The mandate calls for active balanced discretionary investment management of UK and international securities.
The deadline for applications to tender is July 28.
Morris said the current managers of the fund, PDFM and Prudential Corp Plc, had delivered good long term returns, but it had been some time since it had reviewed the mandate.

"It is just part of the process. It has been a long time since we reviewed asset managers and we just deemed it appropriate to go through the process now...We have got very, very good long term performance," he said.
A decision on the mandate was likely to be taken in the run-up to Christmas, he said. It does not cover custody services.
